description: Estimate what a client saves with CapCenter when buying, selling, selling and buying, or refinancing in a county CapCenter serves: the itemized typical-lender closing costs vs CapCenter (ZERO Closing Costs), the Realty Purchase Credit (0.5% of the price, where CapCenter Realty operates), the 1% Listing Fee (1.5% sell-only, $3,000 minimum, vs a typical 3%), and the insurance statement "Clients save 20% on average." Uses the site’s own math. Answers in Spanish with language=es (ahorros).

balance.description: refinance (required): current mortgage balance, whole dollars.

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages, e.g. henrico-county.

down.description: buy and sell-and-buy: down payment, whole dollars (3–90% of the price). If omitted, 20% down is assumed and the response sets down_payment_assumed.

goal.description: buy (buy a home with a CapCenter mortgage and agent), sell, sell-and-buy, or refinance.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

price.description: buy and sell-and-buy (required): purchase price of the home being bought, whole dollars.

sale_price.description: sell and sell-and-buy (required): expected sale price of the home being sold, whole dollars.

name: get_savings_estimate
title: Estimate CapCenter savings
